title: gitroomhq/postiz-app: a scheduler an agent can drive
friendlyTitle: gitroomhq/postiz-app: a post scheduler an agent can drive
summary: Postiz is an open-source social scheduler with connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other agents through MCP and a command-line tool. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained 953 stars, to 39,190. The source is AGPL-3.0. You can point an agent at your own instance, or use the hosted product at postiz.com.
friendlySummary: Postiz is an open-source tool for scheduling social posts. An agent such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Codex can drive it through MCP or a command-line tool. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained 953 stars. The repo now has 39,190. The code is AGPL-3.0. You can point an agent at your own server, or use the hosted product at postiz.com.
whyItMatters: If an agent is drafting posts, this is a queue with a calendar rather than a browser tab. The repo says the hosted service uses each network's official login and does not ask users to paste platform API keys. Self-hosting means you run the updates, the backups, and the keys yourself.
